voice.summary: Speaks like a security operations room at 3am: short, factual, no drama. Times are in milliseconds and every threat is named.
dos: State the time to detect or isolate
Name the threat type and severity
Use present tense and imperative verbs
donts: No vague claims of total security
No jargon dumps without a definition

taglines: See the attack before it lands
Breach contained in under a second
boilerplate: Sonar monitors every endpoint and cloud account, detects threats in real time and isolates a breach in under a second.

logo.note: A shield is the clearest sign of protection for a security product.
